title: Petra and the Asset
author: Coral Thornbury
blurb: Paloma Iversen, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
